title: 世界貿易中心一號大樓
summary: 世界貿易中心一號大樓以約 61 m 見方的基座、逐漸削角收分的體量，把 14,000 psi 高強混凝土核心筒與周邊延性抗彎鋼框架組成混合抗側系統，再以展開基腳與岩錨坐落在曼哈頓岩盤上。本課從削角形體的風荷載、核心筒剛度與替代傳力路徑，走到岩盤基腳、尖塔分段吊裝、大體積高強混凝土的溫控與驗收，最後談強健性設計在營運期的改裝管制與尖塔維護。
summaryEn: One World Trade Center rises from a base about 61 m square with chamfered, tapering faces, combining a 14,000 psi high-strength concrete core and a ductile perimeter steel moment frame into a hybrid lateral system founded on Manhattan bedrock with spread footings and rock anchors. The course moves from wind on the chamfered form, core stiffness and alternate load paths to rock footings, staged spire erection, temperature control and acceptance of high-strength mass concrete, and finally to protecting robustness during later alterations and maintaining the spire.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「削角收分形體與風荷載」與「核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Chamfered tapering form and wind load" and "Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「削角錐形體量」如何影響世界貿易中心一號大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Chamfered tapering massing” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大樓基座約 61 m 見方，四角自低處開始削角，平面在半高處成為八角形，往上逐漸轉成旋轉後的較小方形。迎風寬度隨高度遞減，使高處的風壓作用面積變小，而高處的力臂最長，所以基座傾覆力矩下降得比總風力更明顯；斜切的立面也讓背風側渦流脫落沿高度不同步，削弱橫風向的規律激振。形體因此不只是建築表情，而是降低抗側構件需求的第一道結構手段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「削角錐形體量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The base is about 61 m square, its corners are chamfered from low levels, the plan becomes an octagon at mid-height and transitions toward a smaller rotated square near the top. Because the windward width shrinks with height, the pressure area is smallest where the lever arm is longest, so the base overturning moment falls faster than the total wind force; the inclined faces also desynchronise vortex shedding along the height, weakening regular across-wind excitation. The form is therefore the first structural measure that reduces demand on the lateral system, not just an architectural gesture. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Chamfered tapering massing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：均布風壓 q 下，寬度由 B₀ 線性收到 B₁ 的懸臂，其基座力矩 M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3)；等寬稜柱 M = qH²B₀/2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For uniform pressure q on a cantilever whose width tapers linearly from B₀ to B₁, the base moment is M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3), versus M = qH²B₀/2 for a prism.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「削角錐形體量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Chamfered tapering massing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「削角收分形體與風荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Chamfered tapering form and wind load" is correct?
options: 削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。
大樓基座約 61 m 見方，四角自低處開始削角，平面在半高處成為八角形，往上逐漸轉成旋轉後的較小方形。
核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。
optionsEn: Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads.
The base is about 61 m square, its corners are chamfered from low levels, the plan becomes an octagon at mid-height and transitions toward a smaller rotated square near the top.
A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity.
quiz.explanation: 大樓基座約 61 m 見方，四角自低處開始削角，平面在半高處成為八角形，往上逐漸轉成旋轉後的較小方形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The base is about 61 m square, its corners are chamfered from low levels, the plan becomes an octagon at mid-height and transitions toward a smaller rotated square near the top. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「削角錐形體量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Chamfered tapering massing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：均布風壓 q 下，寬度由 B₀ 線性收到 B₁ 的懸臂，其基座力矩 M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3)；等寬稜柱 M = qH²B₀/2。取 q = 2.0 kPa、H = 417 m、B₀ = 61 m、B₁ = 43 m：稜柱 M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m，收分後 M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m，約減少 19.7%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For uniform pressure q on a cantilever whose width tapers linearly from B₀ to B₁, the base moment is M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3), versus M = qH²B₀/2 for a prism. With q = 2.0 kPa, H = 417 m, B₀ = 61 m and B₁ = 43 m, the prism gives M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m and the tapered form M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m, about 19.7% less. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以剛性模型高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗量測不同風向的基座力矩與扭矩頻譜，與手算的收分折減趨勢及設計風荷載比較；同時檢查最不利風向是否落在削角面或平直面，並確認周邊既有高樓的遮蔽與干擾效應已納入試驗模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run a rigid-model high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel test to measure base moment and torque spectra for each wind direction, and compare them with the hand-calculated taper reduction and the design wind loads; check whether the governing direction strikes a chamfered or a flat face, and confirm that shielding and interference from surrounding towers are modelled.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 均布風壓 q 下，寬度由 B₀ 線性收到 B₁ 的懸臂，其基座力矩 M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3)；等寬稜柱 M = qH²B₀/2。取 q = 2.0 kPa、H = 417 m、B₀ = 61 m、B₁ = 43 m：稜柱 M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m，收分後 M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m，約減少 19.7%。數值為教學假設。

With q = 2.0 kPa, H = 417 m, B₀ = 61 m and B₁ = 43 m, the prism gives M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m and the tapered form M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m, about 19.7% less. knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「削角收分形體與風荷載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Chamfered tapering form and wind load", which statement holds?
options: 只要每根柱子強度足夠，就不需要考慮某根柱失效後的替代路徑。
尖塔不是主結構，吊裝時只要吊車容量足夠就沒有其他限制。
均布風壓 q 下，寬度由 B₀ 線性收到 B₁ 的懸臂，其基座力矩 M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3)；等寬稜柱 M = qH²B₀/2。
optionsEn: If every column is strong enough, alternate load paths after a column loss need not be considered.
A spire is not primary structure, so crane capacity is the only lifting constraint.
For uniform pressure q on a cantilever whose width tapers linearly from B₀ to B₁, the base moment is M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3), versus M = qH²B₀/2 for a prism.
quiz.explanation: 均布風壓 q 下，寬度由 B₀ 線性收到 B₁ 的懸臂，其基座力矩 M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3)；等寬稜柱 M = qH²B₀/2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For uniform pressure q on a cantilever whose width tapers linearly from B₀ to B₁, the base moment is M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3), versus M = qH²B₀/2 for a prism. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「削角錐形體量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Chamfered tapering massing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以剛性模型高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗量測不同風向的基座力矩與扭矩頻譜，與手算的收分折減趨勢及設計風荷載比較；同時檢查最不利風向是否落在削角面或平直面，並確認周邊既有高樓的遮蔽與干擾效應已納入試驗模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a rigid-model high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel test to measure base moment and torque spectra for each wind direction, and compare them with the hand-calculated taper reduction and the design wind loads; check whether the governing direction strikes a chamfered or a flat face, and confirm that shielding and interference from surrounding towers are modelled. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：形體凍結前，結構團隊應以初步風洞或經驗係數比較兩到三種收分方案的基座力矩與加速度，把結果寫入設計基準報告，日後建築外形若再調整須重新取得結構確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before the form is frozen, the structural team should compare base moment and acceleration for two or three taper options using a preliminary wind test or empirical coefficients, record the results in the design basis report, and require structural sign-off for any later change to the massing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振；反之若過度依賴形體折減而風洞未涵蓋周邊建物干擾，某些風向的頂部加速度可能超出居住性準則，完工後才發現擺動與帷幕牆噪音。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing only with a code formula for a uniform prism is conservative for members yet can miss torsion or across-wind resonance in particular directions; conversely, relying on the taper benefit without a wind tunnel that models neighbouring towers can leave some directions exceeding habitability limits, discovered only after completion as sway and façade noise. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以剛性模型高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗量測不同風向的基座力矩與扭矩頻譜，與手算的收分折減趨勢及設計風荷載比較；同時檢查最不利風向是否落在削角面或平直面，並確認周邊既有高樓的遮蔽與干擾效應已納入試驗模型。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 形體凍結前，結構團隊應以初步風洞或經驗係數比較兩到三種收分方案的基座力矩與加速度，把結果寫入設計基準報告，日後建築外形若再調整須重新取得結構確認。

quiz.question: 要驗證「削角收分形體與風荷載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Chamfered tapering form and wind load"?
options: 以剛性模型高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗量測不同風向的基座力矩與扭矩頻譜，與手算的收分折減趨勢及設計風荷載比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
建築越高，風壓只隨高度成正比增加。
optionsEn: Run a rigid-model high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel test to measure base moment and torque spectra for each wind direction, and compare them with the hand-calculated taper reduction and the design wind loads.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Wind pressure simply increases in direct proportion to height.
quiz.explanation: 以剛性模型高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗量測不同風向的基座力矩與扭矩頻譜，與手算的收分折減趨勢及設計風荷載比較；同時檢查最不利風向是否落在削角面或平直面，並確認周邊既有高樓的遮蔽與干擾效應已納入試驗模型。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run a rigid-model high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel test to measure base moment and torque spectra for each wind direction, and compare them with the hand-calculated taper reduction and the design wind loads; check whether the governing direction strikes a chamfered or a flat face, and confirm that shielding and interference from surrounding towers are modelled. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「削角錐形體量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Chamfered tapering massing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振；反之若過度依賴形體折減而風洞未涵蓋周邊建物干擾，某些風向的頂部加速度可能超出居住性準則，完工後才發現擺動與帷幕牆噪音。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing only with a code formula for a uniform prism is conservative for members yet can miss torsion or across-wind resonance in particular directions; conversely, relying on the taper benefit without a wind tunnel that models neighbouring towers can leave some directions exceeding habitability limits, discovered only after completion as sway and façade noise. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：形體因此不只是建築表情，而是降低抗側構件需求的第一道結構手段。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The form is therefore the first structural measure that reduces demand on the lateral system, not just an architectural gesture.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振；反之若過度依賴形體折減而風洞未涵蓋周邊建物干擾，某些風向的頂部加速度可能超出居住性準則，完工後才發現擺動與帷幕牆噪音。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「削角收分形體與風荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Chamfered tapering form and wind load" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振。
核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Designing only with a code formula for a uniform prism is conservative for members yet can miss torsion or across-wind resonance in particular directions.
A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity.
quiz.explanation: 若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振；反之若過度依賴形體折減而風洞未涵蓋周邊建物干擾，某些風向的頂部加速度可能超出居住性準則，完工後才發現擺動與帷幕牆噪音。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing only with a code formula for a uniform prism is conservative for members yet can miss torsion or across-wind resonance in particular directions; conversely, relying on the taper benefit without a wind tunnel that models neighbouring towers can leave some directions exceeding habitability limits, discovered only after completion as sway and façade noise. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」如何影響世界貿易中心一號大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料描述此塔以混凝土核心筒承擔大部分重力並抵抗風與地震，周邊延性抗彎鋼框架與核心筒共同作用；低樓層有跨多層的「超級斜撐」像腰帶一樣環繞，頂部機械層則以外伸臂把周邊柱與核心筒連在一起。核心筒單獨作用時像一根懸臂梁，頂部變位以彎曲為主；外伸臂把周邊柱的軸向勁度轉成限制核心筒旋轉的力偶，周邊框架再提供額外的剪力勁度與冗餘度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public descriptions state that the concrete core carries most of the gravity load and resists wind and earthquake together with a ductile perimeter steel moment frame; multi-storey super diagonals wrap the lower levels like a belt, and outriggers at the upper mechanical levels tie perimeter columns to the core. Acting alone, the core behaves as a cantilever whose top drift is dominated by bending; the outriggers convert the axial stiffness of perimeter columns into a couple that restrains core rotation, and the perimeter frame adds shear stiffness and redundancy. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：僅核心筒時頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With the core alone the top drift is Δ = wH⁴/(8EI).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Core–frame hybrid lateral system”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工
knowledge.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame
knowledge.text: 公開資料描述此塔以混凝土核心筒承擔大部分重力並抵抗風與地震，周邊延性抗彎鋼框架與核心筒共同作用；低樓層有跨多層的「超級斜撐」像腰帶一樣環繞，頂部機械層則以外伸臂把周邊柱與核心筒連在一起。核心筒單獨作用時像一根懸臂梁，頂部變位以彎曲為主；外伸臂把周邊柱的軸向勁度轉成限制核心筒旋轉的力偶，周邊框架再提供額外的剪力勁度與冗餘度。
knowledge.textEn: Public descriptions state that the concrete core carries most of the gravity load and resists wind and earthquake together with a ductile perimeter steel moment frame; multi-storey super diagonals wrap the lower levels like a belt, and outriggers at the upper mechanical levels tie perimeter columns to the core. Acting alone, the core behaves as a cantilever whose top drift is dominated by bending; the outriggers convert the axial stiffness of perimeter columns into a couple that restrains core rotation, and the perimeter frame adds shear stiffness and redundancy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame" is correct?
options: 核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。
混凝土強度越高，彈性模數必然按比例同步提高。
公開資料描述此塔以混凝土核心筒承擔大部分重力並抵抗風與地震，周邊延性抗彎鋼框架與核心筒共同作用。
optionsEn: A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity.
Higher concrete strength always raises the elastic modulus in proportion.
Public descriptions state that the concrete core carries most of the gravity load and resists wind and earthquake together with a ductile perimeter steel moment frame.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料描述此塔以混凝土核心筒承擔大部分重力並抵抗風與地震，周邊延性抗彎鋼框架與核心筒共同作用；低樓層有跨多層的「超級斜撐」像腰帶一樣環繞，頂部機械層則以外伸臂把周邊柱與核心筒連在一起。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Public descriptions state that the concrete core carries most of the gravity load and resists wind and earthquake together with a ductile perimeter steel moment frame; multi-storey super diagonals wrap the lower levels like a belt, and outriggers at the upper mechanical levels tie perimeter columns to the core. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：僅核心筒時頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。取外邊 33.5 m、壁厚 1.2 m 的方形管 I = (33.5⁴ − 31.1⁴)/12 ≈ 27,000 m⁴、E = 48 GPa、w = 2.0 kPa×61 m = 122 kN/m、H = 417 m：Δ = 122×417⁴/(8×48×10⁶×27,000) ≈ 0.356 m，約 H/1,170；若外伸臂與框架使等效勁度提高 40%，Δ ≈ 0.254 m，約 H/1,640。數值為教學假設，忽略開口與內牆。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With the core alone the top drift is Δ = wH⁴/(8EI). For a square tube 33.5 m outside with 1.2 m walls, I = (33.5⁴ − 31.1⁴)/12 ≈ 27,000 m⁴; with E = 48 GPa, w = 2.0 kPa×61 m = 122 kN/m and H = 417 m, Δ = 122×417⁴/(8×48×10⁶×27,000) ≈ 0.356 m, about H/1,170. If outriggers and frame raise the effective stiffness by 40%, Δ ≈ 0.254 m, about H/1,640. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring openings and interior walls. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在三維有限元素模型中分別關閉外伸臂、周邊框架與超級斜撐，比較頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒基座力矩的分配，確認每個子系統的貢獻與手算一致；再以實際混凝土模數與開裂勁度折減做敏感度分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the three-dimensional finite-element model, switch off the outriggers, perimeter frame and super diagonals in turn and compare top drift, inter-storey drift ratios and the share of core base moment, confirming that each subsystem's contribution agrees with hand estimates; then run sensitivity studies with the actual concrete modulus and cracked-stiffness reductions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 僅核心筒時頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。取外邊 33.5 m、壁厚 1.2 m 的方形管 I = (33.5⁴ − 31.1⁴)/12 ≈ 27,000 m⁴、E = 48 GPa、w = 2.0 kPa×61 m = 122 kN/m、H = 417 m：Δ = 122×417⁴/(8×48×10⁶×27,000) ≈ 0.356 m，約 H/1,170；若外伸臂與框架使等效勁度提高 40%，Δ ≈ 0.254 m，約 H/1,640。數值為教學假設，忽略開口與內牆。
knowledge.textEn: With the core alone the top drift is Δ = wH⁴/(8EI). For a square tube 33.5 m outside with 1.2 m walls, I = (33.5⁴ − 31.1⁴)/12 ≈ 27,000 m⁴; with E = 48 GPa, w = 2.0 kPa×61 m = 122 kN/m and H = 417 m, Δ = 122×417⁴/(8×48×10⁶×27,000) ≈ 0.356 m, about H/1,170. If outriggers and frame raise the effective stiffness by 40%, Δ ≈ 0.254 m, about H/1,640. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring openings and interior walls.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame", which statement holds?
options: 僅核心筒時頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。
坐落在岩盤上的基礎不會沉陷，也不需要上拔設計。
高強混凝土只要試體強度合格，就代表結構內部的混凝土品質一定合格。
optionsEn: With the core alone the top drift is Δ = wH⁴/(8EI).
Foundations on bedrock never settle and never need uplift design.
If high-strength cylinders pass, the concrete inside the structure must be acceptable.
quiz.explanation: 僅核心筒時頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With the core alone the top drift is Δ = wH⁴/(8EI). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在三維有限元素模型中分別關閉外伸臂、周邊框架與超級斜撐，比較頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒基座力矩的分配，確認每個子系統的貢獻與手算一致；再以實際混凝土模數與開裂勁度折減做敏感度分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the three-dimensional finite-element model, switch off the outriggers, perimeter frame and super diagonals in turn and compare top drift, inter-storey drift ratios and the share of core base moment, confirming that each subsystem's contribution agrees with hand estimates; then run sensitivity studies with the actual concrete modulus and cracked-stiffness reductions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計基準應明列抗側系統的分工比例與每個子系統的容許變位角，並規定外伸臂的接合時機與調整機制，施工圖上要標示哪些接頭須待指定階段才能最終鎖定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should state how lateral resistance is shared and the allowable drift for each subsystem, define when and how outriggers are connected, and mark on the drawings which joints may only be finally locked at a specified construction stage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若模型高估核心筒勁度（例如未考慮連梁開裂或開口），實際變位與加速度會大於預測；若外伸臂在施工期就剛性鎖定，核心筒與周邊柱的差異縮短會在外伸臂內鎖入巨大附加力，造成接頭或牆體開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the model overestimates core stiffness, for example by ignoring cracked coupling beams or openings, real drift and acceleration exceed predictions; if outriggers are locked rigidly during construction, differential shortening between core and perimeter columns locks large additional forces into them and can crack connections or walls. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在三維有限元素模型中分別關閉外伸臂、周邊框架與超級斜撐，比較頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒基座力矩的分配，確認每個子系統的貢獻與手算一致；再以實際混凝土模數與開裂勁度折減做敏感度分析。
knowledge.textEn: In the three-dimensional finite-element model, switch off the outriggers, perimeter frame and super diagonals in turn and compare top drift, inter-storey drift ratios and the share of core base moment, confirming that each subsystem's contribution agrees with hand estimates; then run sensitivity studies with the actual concrete modulus and cracked-stiffness reductions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計基準應明列抗側系統的分工比例與每個子系統的容許變位角，並規定外伸臂的接合時機與調整機制，施工圖上要標示哪些接頭須待指定階段才能最終鎖定。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis should state how lateral resistance is shared and the allowable drift for each subsystem, define when and how outriggers are connected, and mark on the drawings which joints may only be finally locked at a specified construction stage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在三維有限元素模型中分別關閉外伸臂、周邊框架與超級斜撐，比較頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒基座力矩的分配，確認每個子系統的貢獻與手算一致。
強健性只在設計階段處理，完工後就不會改變。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

In the three-dimensional finite-element model, switch off the outriggers, perimeter frame and super diagonals in turn and compare top drift, inter-storey drift ratios and the share of core base moment, confirming that each subsystem's contribution agrees with hand estimates.
Robustness is settled at design and cannot change after completion.
quiz.explanation: 在三維有限元素模型中分別關閉外伸臂、周邊框架與超級斜撐，比較頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒基座力矩的分配，確認每個子系統的貢獻與手算一致；再以實際混凝土模數與開裂勁度折減做敏感度分析。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In the three-dimensional finite-element model, switch off the outriggers, perimeter frame and super diagonals in turn and compare top drift, inter-storey drift ratios and the share of core base moment, confirming that each subsystem's contribution agrees with hand estimates; then run sensitivity studies with the actual concrete modulus and cracked-stiffness reductions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若模型高估核心筒勁度（例如未考慮連梁開裂或開口），實際變位與加速度會大於預測；若外伸臂在施工期就剛性鎖定，核心筒與周邊柱的差異縮短會在外伸臂內鎖入巨大附加力，造成接頭或牆體開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the model overestimates core stiffness, for example by ignoring cracked coupling beams or openings, real drift and acceleration exceed predictions; if outriggers are locked rigidly during construction, differential shortening between core and perimeter columns locks large additional forces into them and can crack connections or walls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：核心筒單獨作用時像一根懸臂梁，頂部變位以彎曲為主；外伸臂把周邊柱的軸向勁度轉成限制核心筒旋轉的力偶，周邊框架再提供額外的剪力勁度與冗餘度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acting alone, the core behaves as a cantilever whose top drift is dominated by bending; the outriggers convert the axial stiffness of perimeter columns into a couple that restrains core rotation, and the perimeter frame adds shear stiffness and redundancy.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若模型高估核心筒勁度（例如未考慮連梁開裂或開口），實際變位與加速度會大於預測；若外伸臂在施工期就剛性鎖定，核心筒與周邊柱的差異縮短會在外伸臂內鎖入巨大附加力，造成接頭或牆體開裂。
knowledge.textEn: If the model overestimates core stiffness, for example by ignoring cracked coupling beams or openings, real drift and acceleration exceed predictions; if outriggers are locked rigidly during construction, differential shortening between core and perimeter columns locks large additional forces into them and can crack connections or walls.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
混凝土強度越高，彈性模數必然按比例同步提高。
若模型高估核心筒勁度（例如未考慮連梁開裂或開口），實際變位與加速度會大於預測。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Higher concrete strength always raises the elastic modulus in proportion.

quiz.explanationEn: If the model overestimates core stiffness, for example by ignoring cracked coupling beams or openings, real drift and acceleration exceed predictions; if outriggers are locked rigidly during construction, differential shortening between core and perimeter columns locks large additional forces into them and can crack connections or walls. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
